title: How a perpetual calendar actually works
hook: How A Perpetual Calendar Knows February
why: Replaces a duplicate GMT post. Explain in plain words how a perpetual calendar tracks month lengths and leap years (the 48-month wheel), 2-3 library watches that have it (photo.js list) with dated prices. Cover = the movement or calendar mechanism close-up (brand movement image), the most striking picture. Not GMT, tachymeter or chronograph (all posted in the last 2 days).

verdict.reason: The check passes. The cover now shows a real watch movement, the Seiko and Tissot slides no longer use discount prices, and slide 3 has its headline and names the Patek in the caption. The remaining weak spots are minor: the prices read 'on request', and slide 2 is a dim pocket-watch photo that still reads.
